Name: Shop Items
Author: HamBandit
Description:
[center]Shop Items is a mod that allows you to add items to shops.

Each Shop can have up to 10 items of your choice added to their inventories.
To add an item to a shop, simply look up the ItemID of the item you would like the shop to sell and plug it in!

Items added to shops can have a unlock requirement applied to them, consisting of the following options:
- Always available
- Lowest level reached in Mines
- Player Combat level
- Player Farming level
- Player Foraging level
- Player Fishing level
- Player Mining level
- Random chance each day
- Season
- Year

Each of these unlock requirements can have a value applied to them, to designate exactly when you like your items to become available.

To find ItemIDs of items, I recommend using a resource such as: [url=https://mateusaquino.github.io/stardewids/]Stardew IDs[/url]﻿﻿

(Big thanks to [url=https://github.com/MateusAquino/stardewids]MateusAquino[/url]﻿ for making this extremely useful website)

Use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make editing the shop items even easier.

------

This mod is split into 3 smaller mods:
ShopItems
ShopItems - AsstFestivals
ShopItems - DesertFestival

Each of these mods is standalone and does not require the others for it to work.
For Example: If you do not plan to make changes to the Desert Festival, you can remove that section of the mod.

------

[size=4][b]PREMADE CONFIG:[/b][/size]

"ShopItems" contains a config file that adds about 10 items to 11 different shops (104 total), all with unique unlock requirements/prices/stock amounts.
This config is ready to play, or can be used as a guide on how to set up your own items!
[b][size=3]
View the "Docs" tab to see all the items added to each shop in this config![/size][/b]

If you do not wish to use the pre-made config, simply click "Default" in the Generic Mod Config Menu and all shop items will be reset to vanilla values (no added items).

"ShopItems - AsstFestivals" and "ShopItems - DesertFestival" does not include a pre-made config file and by default do not add anything to any of their respective shops!

------

[size=4][b]OPTIONAL FILE:[/b][/size]

"ShopItems (11-20 items)" is an extra stand-alone mod that adds an ADDITIONAL 10 items to all non-festival shops! If you need to really buff up Pelican Town's shops, this should be quite useful![size=1][b]
